scope: Original formulations; excludes our adapted-baseline error measurements

sections: A.1--A.4: GCMC labels and planar local network
Sammuller2023.interpretation: Learning c1 directly does not impose the Helmholtz condition; this is an architectural inference, not a claim that the published tests failed.

sections: Main text, Eqs. 1--3: mimic-system GCMC labels
Main text, network description: independent cation/anion networks
Main text, Eqs. 5 and 8--12: screening, LMFT and line integration
Supplement S7: planar local input and optional bulk correlation matching
BuiCox2025.interpretation: Separate direct-output networks do not impose cross-species functional reciprocity. Long-range electrostatics and screening are already addressed in the original paper.

sections: II.1, Eqs. 2--5: cubic-grid CACE and Oh invariance
II.2, Eqs. 6--9: free-energy derivatives, canonical centered balance and gauge

V.2: one-component LJTS and full 3D training fields
Cheng2026.interpretation: Integrability and 3D geometry are shared capabilities. Cubic-group invariance alone is insufficient to infer continuous translation/rotation Noether identities.

This work.interpretation: Continuum radial invariance precedes discretization; exact transformations are restricted by the domain. Tests of full 3D inhomogeneity are not claimed.

larger_domain_evaluation.criterion: Architectural applicability with the same learned parameters; not a claim that all original papers report a larger-box experiment.
larger_domain_evaluation.Sammuller2023: Local planar window; original larger-column example.
larger_domain_evaluation.BuiCox2025: Local planar windows with analytic LMFT electrostatics; larger-domain applicability inferred from the published representation.
larger_domain_evaluation.Cheng2026: Shared local grid functional, explicit larger-cell transfer test.
larger_domain_evaluation.This work: Radial convolutions and pointwise map; repeated-potential tests at 2L, 4L and 8L and aperiodic-potential tests at 2L.

one_dimensional_training_two_dimensional.criterion: Demonstrated in the cited original study; crosses mean not demonstrated, not impossibility.
one_dimensional_training_two_dimensional.Cheng2026_training: Original V.2 uses fully three-dimensional training fields.
one_dimensional_training_two_dimensional.This_work_test: Periodic and aperiodic two-dimensional potentials; SI S4.1.

spatial_transferability_row.criterion: Reuse of the learned model across both domain sizes and nonplanar density-field geometries. This combines the two previous transfer rows.
spatial_transferability_row.interpretation: The first two original formulations transfer across planar domain sizes, but do not support nonplanar fields as formulated. Cheng demonstrates larger-cell and nonplanar-geometry transfer after 3D training. This work demonstrates larger-domain and 2D predictions after planar-only training; that distinct training requirement remains explicit in the abstract and Introduction.

transfer_without_fixed_discretization_ro.criterion: Learned representation and parameters defined independently of the evaluation grid; numerical quadrature errors remain possible. Resampling inputs to an unchanged fixed input grid does not meet this criterion.

sources.Sammuller2023: Published local network takes a sampled density window of fixed dimension.
sources.BuiCox2025: Supplement S7.2; sampled planar density windows feed fixed-dimension networks.
sources.Cheng2026: https://arxiv.org/html/2608.13506v1, IV: larger-cell transfer at unchanged grid spacing; transfer across resolution remains open.
sources.This work: Continuum radial kernels and pointwise density functional; numerical grid used for evaluation.
